steps.code:
# We need to keep calling next_song until we reach a liked song.
# We already moved to song_id 56 (not liked). Continue from there.
liked_ids = {song['song_id'] for song in liked_songs}
found = False
for step in range(20):
    result = apis.spotify.next_song(access_token=access_token)
    new_id = result.get('song_id')
    print(f"Step {step+1}: moved to song_id {new_id}")
    if new_id in liked_ids:
        title = next((s['title'] for s in queue if s['song_id'] == new_id), 'Unknown')
        print(f"Found liked song: {new_id} - {title}")
        found = True
        break
if not found:
    print("No liked song found after 20 steps")
